ex.en: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ
And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah
[It is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know
Indeed, you are in differing speech
Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do
And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason
I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all

forms.gloss: to succeed, take the place of

ex.en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth

And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, he can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people

Those who remained behind rejoiced in their staying [at home] after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah and disliked to strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah and said, "Do not go forth in the heat." Say, "The fire of Hell is more intensive in heat" - if they would but understand
They were satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and their hearts were sealed over, so they do not understand

Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment
So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution
Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward

If Allah should return you to a faction of them [after the expedition] and then they ask your permission to go out [to battle], say, "You will not go out with me, ever, and you will never fight with me an enemy. Indeed, you were satisfied with sitting [at home] the first time, so sit [now] with those who stay behind
And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude

And [He also forgave] the three who were left behind [and regretted their error] to the point that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness and their souls confined them and they were certain that there is no refuge from Allah except in Him. Then He turned to them so they could repent. Indeed, Allah is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

It was not [proper] for the people of Madinah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah or that they prefer themselves over his self. That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of Allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that is registered for them as a righteous deed. Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good
